property_summary: After calling cancel(order) by the order.maker, the cancelledOrders[hashOrder(order)] observable getter becomes true and remains true (cancel returns no revert), and cancel must revert if caller != order.maker.

Only the order.maker can successfully call cancel(order): when caller==maker, cancel does not revert and cancelledOrders[hashOrder(order)] becomes true; otherwise cancel reverts and the mapping stays false.
Filling an order with isLong==true transfers the premium (minus fee) from the maker to the filler and increases contract's unclaimedFees for the order.baseAsset by fee amount when fee>0.
When a caller who is not the order.maker attempts to cancel(order), the call must revert and cancelledOrders(orderHash) must remain false.
